description: Record a payment for an apartment. Defaults to status COMPLETED paid today. For prepayment of several months pass startDate and endDate (YYYY-MM); the debt calculation covers every month in that range. Pass cashBox true when the money went into the building cash box (CASH payments only; it defaults to true for CASH).

cashBox.description: True when the money went into the building cash box. Only meaningful for CASH payments; other methods ignore it. Defaults to true for CASH and false otherwise.

endDate.description: Whole-month coverage end. For a 5-month prepayment use startDate '2026-09' and endDate '2027-01'. Any supplied day is normalized to the last day of its month.

paidDate.description: Date the payment was paid. Defaults to today in the building time zone when status is COMPLETED.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used when marking the payment COMPLETED. Defaults to BANK_TRANSFER.

referenceNumber.description: Optional bank, cheque, card, or other transaction reference.

startDate.description: Whole-month coverage start. For a 5-month prepayment use startDate '2026-09' and endDate '2027-01'. Any supplied day is normalized to the first day of its month.

status.description: Payment status. The tool applies COMPLETED when this field is omitted.

name: record_payment
title: Record payment
